title: Finding
description: One judgement of a discovery run, one JSON object per line of run/findings/findings.jsonl (and run/findings/ai.jsonl). Docs: docs/walkthrough/13-findings-and-gaps.md

id.description: Stable: hash of kind and a key that does not depend on the run (no timestamps). Same finding on the same code = same id.

statement.description: One or two plain sentences: what is true, and why it matters.

method.description: How it was found: static = files and CAP's compiler only; measured = the running app answered; ai = an LLM, through the evidence gate; human = a person (curated file).

source.description: The tool or rule that produced it, e.g. risks.js#pii-open, reflexion-ui, opengrep:max-plus-one-id, agent:gap-resolver.

status.description: detected = a deterministic rule fired on the code; suspected = heuristic, draft rule or AI, needs a check; confirmed = measured or reviewed; refuted = a measurement or review showed it is not so.

layer.description: UI, Annotations, Service, Node, Model, DB, Config, Tests

evidence.description: Where in the app it can be seen. Empty only for findings about the whole project (then subjects names it).

subjects.description: Graph node ids (run/graph/nodes.jsonl) the finding is about.

test.description: The request or test that would show it.

gaps.description: Open questions this finding raises (ids in gaps.jsonl).

resolves.description: Gaps this finding settles (measured, ai or human findings).

about.description: Other findings this one confirms, refutes or details.

stage.description: Stage id from lib/stages.js that wrote it.

data.description: Kind-specific details, documented per kind in docs/walkthrough/13-findings-and-gaps.md.

file.description: Path relative to the app root (may start with ../ for a reuse package).

quote.description: Verbatim text at or within two lines of the line. Required for method ai.
